changelog: Audio quality in Settings now uses the same Material icon treatment as the other settings rows
Tapping a lyric line seeks without drawing a rectangular ripple behind the line
Reopening Meoify restores the last song, queue and position even after the app was stopped
The Played count on a signed-in YouTube Music account refreshes when Settings opens and follows listens as they sync
Pausing and clearing Meoify from recents stops the background service instead of leaving it running
Playback controls reconnect automatically when the service was stopped while Meoify was in the background
